description:
I'm a software engineering interested in AI, machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and software engineering. I enjoy building projects that combine intelligent systems with practical applications.

For this hackathon, I'm interested in building MarsMind, a heterogeneous agentic AI swarm for autonomous planetary exploration. The idea is to create multiple specialized rover agents that can collaboratively explore Mars, build shared spatial maps, identify interesting scientific locations.
summary: MarsMind is a digital twin and simulation platform for coordinated semi-autonomous planetary exploration. Instead of relying on one rover to perform every task, it organizes three specialized agents into a cooperative system. Each has a distinct operational focus while sharing spatial intelligence, mission context, and coordination mechanisms. This project is an attempt to educate the operator about the tasks and challenges that may be present within a space exploration
details: MarsMind is a semi-autonomous exploration simulation where specialized rover agents navigate, map, investigate, and coordinate across an unknown planetary terrain. Instead of relying on one rover to perform every task, it organizes three specialized agents into a cooperative system. Each has a distinct operational focus while sharing spatial intelligence, mission context, and coordination mechanisms. The rovers will land on a site on a body and they will cooperate to accomplish various tasks. This project aims to help the operator understand the challenge within space and the cooperation required by each unit to accomplish a task. This project is built with Javascript, HTML, CSS and Python. the mars surface of this project using NASA data to make the terrain of mars.
